concept.description: Persistent entity type (label :Entity, properties tableSchema and tableName).

constraint.description: An entity must live in the database schema owned by its module (parameter moduleSchemas = 'module=schema;module=schema').
constraint.cypher: MATCH (m:Module) WITH collect(m) AS mods MATCH (e:Type:Entity) WHERE NOT e:Test AND $moduleSchemas <> '' WITH e, [x IN mods WHERE e.fqn STARTS WITH x.fqn + '.'][0] AS m WHERE m IS NOT NULL WITH e, m, [p IN split($moduleSchemas, ';') WHERE trim(split(p, '=')[0]) = m.name][0] AS pair WHERE pair IS NOT NULL AND trim(split(pair, '=')[1]) <> '' AND coalesce(e.tableSchema, '') <> trim(split(pair, '=')[1]) RETURN e AS Element, e.fqn AS Fqn, 'schema ' + coalesce(e.tableSchema, '<none>') + ' but module ' + m.name + ' owns ' + trim(split(pair, '=')[1]) AS Detail

constraint.description: A module must not use the entities or repositories of another module directly: go through the other module's API.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (m:Module) WITH collect(m) AS mods MATCH (t1:Type)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(t2:Type) WHERE NOT t1:Test AND (t2:Entity OR t2:Repository) WITH t1, t2, [x IN mods WHERE t1.fqn STARTS WITH x.fqn + '.'][0] AS m1, [x IN mods WHERE t2.fqn STARTS WITH x.fqn + '.'][0] AS m2 WHERE m1 IS NOT NULL AND m2 IS NOT NULL AND m1 <> m2 RETURN DISTINCT t1 AS Element, t1.fqn AS Fqn, t2.fqn AS Detail

group.description: xc-data-integrity - schema ownership of entities (abstract labels only)
